review_candidates.title: Lead Tooling Engineer (Progressive Stamping)
review_candidates.description: Company Overview Our client is a Premier Multinational Precision Engineering & Advanced Manufacturing Corporation , specializing in high-precision stamped components, progressive metal forming, and electro-mechanical tooling for the global electronics, semiconductor, and high-tech industrial sectors. Backed by state-of-the-art CNC, Wire-EDM, and automated stamping infrastructure, the organization delivers complex, high-tolerance mechanical solutions to international Tier-1 technology brands. To strengthen internal tooling innovation, lead toolroom manpower, and drive aggressive cost-down initiatives, the engineering leadership is seeking a hands-on, leadership-oriented Lead Tooling Engineer (Progressive Stamping) . Position Overview Reporting to the Tooling Manager and collaborating directly with the Operations Director , the Lead Tooling Engineer serves as the primary technical authority and shopfloor operational lead for precision stamping tooling. This role holds end-to-end accountability for progressive die design, blanking tools, die fabrication, troubleshooting, and continuous optimization . Beyond deep technical execution, the incumbent bridges engineering and operations—leading toolroom manpower, presenting Capex/tooling engineering proposals, managing external toolmakers, and executing measurable yield and cost-saving programs. Key Responsibilities 1. Progressive Tooling Development & Technical Ownership Lead tooling projects from concept formulation through DFM, design review, fabrication, trial tuning, buy-off, and mass production handover. Serve as the core subject matter expert in progressive die design, blanking tools, compound dies, and multi-stage metal stamping . Interface directly with product design teams, program managers, and customers to translate technical component specifications into robust stamping die designs. Oversee CNC machining, Wire-EDM programming parameters, and toolroom assembly tolerances to ensure dies strictly adhere to micron-level customer drawings. 2. Toolroom Leadership, Manpower Planning & Proposals Supervise, coach, and direct CNC/EDM programmers, toolmakers, and stamping line technicians. Formulate manpower scheduling, technician shift allocation, and toolroom workload balancing to meet aggressive production deadlines. Prepare, structure, and present formal engineering proposals, tooling Capex justifications, and project milestone updates to senior operational leadership and the Operations Director. Drive team discipline, shopfloor safety standards, and conflict resolution across cross-functional engineering groups. 3. Tooling Buy-Off, Supplier Audits & Quality Systems Monitor external tool manufacturers and fabrication vendors through rigorous design reviews, on-site tool audits, and buy-off checklists. Develop and standardize tooling Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), die maintenance work instructions, and site acceptance testing (SAT) criteria. Ensure newly commissioned jigs, fixtures, and stamping presses meet Master Production Schedule (MPS) timelines and part quality specifications. 4. Continuous Improvement & Cost-Saving Initiatives Drive value-engineering and cost-down initiatives across all stamping lines—including die life extension, raw material strip yield optimization, scrap reduction, and regrinding cycle improvements. Lead root-cause failure investigations (8D, 5-Why) for recurring stamping defects (burrs, misfeeds, slug pulling, cracking, dimension drift) and implement permanent die modifications. Introduce modern tooling coatings, sensor technologies, and automation retrofits to enhance press speed, stroke efficiency, and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE). Requirements Education: Bachelor’s Degree or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Precision Tooling / Mold Design, or equivalent technical credentials. Work Experience: Minimum 5+ years of progressive hands-on experience in precision stamping tooling, with a strong preference for candidates from the precision electronics, connector, semiconductor leadframe, or micro-mechanics industries. Technical Mastery: In-depth expertise in Progressive Stamping Dies (strip layout, punch and die clearance, spring-back compensation, forming, blanking). Proficient in interpreting complex GD&T engineering blueprints, CAD/CAM modeling, and toolroom fabrication processes (Wire-EDM, CNC, surface grinding). Demonstrated track record of successful new tool trials, debugging, tuning, and production buy-off. Leadership & Soft Skills: Proven leadership capability to manage toolmakers, organize operational manpower, and mentor junior technicians. Strong executive presentation skills with the ability to articulate technical proposals, project budgets, and cost-benefit analyses to senior management. Demonstrated commercial mindset with documented achievements in scrap reduction, cycle-time improvement, or tooling cost savings.

Role Description Form Energy is seeking a Lead System Integration Engineer to serve as the critical technical bridge between our Battery Management System (BMS) Hardware and Software teams. In this role, you will be the connective tissue that ensures complex PCBA designs and embedded software modules are seamlessly integrated and rigorously aligned with high-level system requirements. You will own the technical stewardship of the BMS integration lifecycle, driving the architectural coherence and functional performance necessary to deliver our groundbreaking 100-hour iron-air energy storage systems. Establish and manage Interface Control Documents (ICDs) and Hardware-Software Interface (HSI) definitions to govern communication and clear pinout expectations. Oversee the development of validation and integration plans, including the use of Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) and System Integration Test Beds to verify safety and reliability under diverse conditions. Drive the execution of Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (DFMEA) and Circuit FMEA (CFMEA) to proactively identify and mitigate integration-level risks. Act as the central partner for Design, Test, and Validation teams, reconciling interface nonconformities and maintaining architectural integrity from prototype to production. What You'll Bring 7+ years of experience in systems engineering, product integration, or technical lead roles within deep-tech industries (e.g., Energy Storage, Automotive, or Aerospace). Deep knowledge across multiple disciplines, including electrical schematic analysis, power electronics, and embedded real-time software development. Mastery of requirement management tools (e.g., Jama, Polarion, or DOORS) and Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) tools such as Catia Magic or SysML. Demonstrated experience with Battery Management Systems, including battery charging/discharging logic, thermal monitoring, and fault management strategies. Strong command of the Systems Engineering V-model and familiarity with functional safety standards (ISO 26262, IEC 61508, or UL 1998). Proven ability to conduct root-cause analysis for complex system-level failures and conduct detailed power and load budget analyses. Exceptional technical communication skills with the ability to translate high-level product goals into actionable technical strategies for multidisciplinary teams. When it comes to you and your family’s health, we cover 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for full-time employees - and 80% of healthcare premiums for dependents. This starts from day one. We also offer at least 12 weeks of paid leave for new parents (up to 20 weeks for birthing parents), and generous vacation policies to give employees time to recharge when needed. To build America’s energy future, we need everyone at the table. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply to our open jobs. If you may require reasonable accommodations to participate in our interview process, please contact accommodations@formenergy.com. Requests for accommodations will be treated with discretion. Form Energy is committed to maintaining the privacy of our applicants. Please be aware that we will never solicit sensitive personal information such as Social Security numbers or bank account details during the recruiting or hiring process. This position reports directly to the Regional HR Manager, Europe.
